title: Picker
description:
Job Purpose:
To safely and accurately pick garments from the warehouse pick locations according to the work orders and place them in the staging area for processing. Demonstrate culture, strong work ethics, goal attainment, and attention to detail.

Daily Responsibilities:
  • Use a pick cart to pick and process garment orders according to customer requirements by accurately matching correct garments to proper work orders.
  • Ensure that work reaches the correct department.
  • Stage carts appropriately for Direct Embroidery Operators, Garment Processor Operators, Emblem Embroidery Operators, etc.
  • Communicate any equipment problems to the Maintenance/Production Supervisor.
  • Process orders by order type priority and ship date.
  • Must meet or exceed picker production standards.

title: Material Handler
description:
Climate controlled environment
Weekly Pay
 
Description:
Supports the Production area by supplying all production material needed to machine and pack parts by a forklift or tugger. Strictly follows internal systems for production inventory control. Keeps the Warehouse clean and organized.
 
Duties:
  • Follows all Company policies as directed by the Employee Handbook, the Safety Rules and Regulations, and the Quality Manual.
  • Completes internal forklift certification program. Conducts and documents pre-shift inspection of forklift.
  • Dumps scrap bins.
  • Supplies component parts and empty totes to the Production line by tugger.
  • Supplies raw material, WIP, rack and pallet to the Production line by forklift with the exception of KP Final Driver.
  • Takes finished goods and work-in-process to the warehouse with the exception of KP finished goods racks.
  • Removes surplus totes, racks, and packaging to external warehouse.
  • Pull and replace miscellaneous boxes on warehouse flow racks.
  • Properly handles material to prevent accidents or the damage of material.
  • Practices FIFO of materials at all times.
  • Follows Kanban System for each department.
  • Reports any irregular situations or low inventory levels within limited scope of knowledge, to the Production Group Leader
  • Assists with TPM and 5S for Dock and Warehouse.
 
Skills/Experience:
  • 2 years previous forklift experience preferred.
  • Current Motor Vehicle License.
  • Good customer service skills.
  • Good safety record.
  • Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time
  • Ability to maneuver around the Plant
  • Ability to continuously mount and dismount forklift or other material handling equipment, repeatedly bend, squat, move both arms above the head, and move head straight up and down and side to side
  • Good hand strength, good finger dexterity, repeatedly able to grasp small and large objects and ability to rotate wrists, arms, and shoulders
  • Good eyesight and hearing; and Ability to lift approximately 25 lbs.
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
Working Conditions:
Work is performed in a manufacturing environment with several potential workplace hazards. All safety rules, regulations and precautions are to be implemented when working around machines and chemicals to keep employees and others safe

title: Finishing / Sorting
description:
GENERAL SUMMARY (Describe the overall duties and responsibilities of the job):
 
Responsible for the quality, assembly, and inspection of fluid components and assemblies within the assigned Business Unit. 
 
 
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  (Duties required for successful job performance):
 
  1. Load work station with formed hoses and other miscellaneous production materials.
  2. Retrieve/return required production fixtures/tooling.
  3. Operate required production fixtures/tooling apparatus.
  4. Operate automatic or hand activated stamping equipment.
  5. Operate various production machines that are required as part of production process.
  6. Perform various re-inspection of product as directed
  7. Perform various salvage operations of product as directed.
  8. Perform set-up/first piece quality inspection per TS 16949 documentation.
  9. Fill out manufacturing slips.
  10. Tally production for timecard.
  11. Maintain work areas neat and orderly in accordance with 5S principles.
  12. Read ID/OD check gauges.
  13. Read Specifications/Standard Practices and sign off appropriate documentation as required.
  14. Perform all operations per specification, standard practice, or as directed by supervision.
  15. Daily and weekly overtime may be required.
  16. May on occasion be required to perform duties other than those listed in this job description.
 
 





REQUIRED EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE (These are the traditional minimum, or required, bona-fide occupational qualifications and other requirements of most people in this job).
 
  1. High School Diploma or GED required.  Previous manufacturing experience preferred (particularly in a team environment).
  2. NCRC certified preferred.
 
REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those needed to perform the essential functions of the job).
 
  1. Interpersonal Skills – Must be able to read and write at a medium level for the purpose of understanding and applying quality documentation and standard operating procedures, along with completion of job / time reporting.
  2. Problem-solving – May be asked to participate in continuous improvement activities and perform basic mathematics.
  3. Physical / Mental / Visual abilities – Duties of job require periods of standing, use of hands and fingers, bending and reaching, lifting and movement of materials frequently.  Must be able to visually interpret work instructions and inspect parts to ensure compliance to quality standards.  Must be able to understand and use assembly and measuring equipment / tools require for position.  Duties of job require periods of standing 95% excluding breaks, use of hands (pushing and pulling 50 lbs.) and fingers (gripping/pinching), bending and reaching up to 33% of the time, lifting (>25lbs.) and movement of materials frequently between 12-38lbs.
  4. Work Hours – The ability to work 40 hours per week, plus daily and/or weekly overtime is required for this position.
 
 
REQUIRED DECISION-MAKING AND ORGANIZATION IMPACT (Describe the typical types of decisions made by employees in this job and the likely impact of those decisions on the Company).
 
  1. The position will decide on a daily basis the acceptable level of quality for finished product to be shipped to the customer. 
  2. This determination will be based upon interpretation of the customer specifications and past experience. 
  3. Customer rejections of finished product could incur additional costs and may jeopardize the sourcing of business to the company.
 
REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS (Indicate job titles for this job’s supervisor and direct reports).
 
  1. Directly Reports To: Group Leader / Shift Supervisor
  2. Indirectly Reports To:  Business Unit Manager - II
 
WORKING CONDITIONS (Describe the environment within which the work is performed).
 
  1. Work time will be spent in general factory floor environments. 
  2. Daily and weekly overtime may be required.
  3. Temperature and noise may vary depending on external environmental conditions.
  4. Lack of attention and carelessness may result in personal injury to self or others.

  6. Position full baskets with proper job and employee clock numbers.

  9. Replenish lubricant in trough as needed.

title: Assembler
description:
Job Description

Ignite your career at Builders FirstSource, America's largest supplier of building materials, value-added components and building services to the professional market. The #1 name in our industry, we help make the dream of home ownership more achievable every day. At BFS, you'll be equipped with all the tools, training, and resources you need, and you'll be empowered to try new things, gain new experiences, and build a career with unlimited horizons.

PURPOSE
Operates basic saw types such as pop-up, miter, web saws, etc. to cut planks, timbers, or boards according to work orders by performing the following duties.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reviews work order to determine cut(s) to be made.
  • Adjusts saw for required cuts.
  • Adjusts speed of saw and feed rolls.
  • Observes automatic feeding of lumber to saw or pushes end of lumber into feed rolls.
  • Stacks cut lumber after processing.
  • Advises supervisor of dull saw blades.
  • Other duties as assigned

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Less than high school education; or up to one month related experience or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

COMPETENCIES

  • Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in situations; Listens and gets clarification when needed.
  • Teamwork - Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.
  • Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
  • Quantity - Meets productivity standards; Completes work in timely manner; Strives to increase productivity; Works quickly.
  • Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Determines appropriate action beyond guidelines; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and materials properly.
  • Attendance/Punctuality - Is consistently at work and on time.
  • Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.
  • Language Skills - Ability to read a limited number of two- and three-syllable words and to recognize similarities and differences between words and between series of numbers. Ability to print and speak simple sentences.

Mathematical Skills - Ability to add and subtract two digit numbers and to multiply and divide with 10's and 100's. Ability to read at tape measure at 1/16 inch. Reasoning Ability - Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out simple one- or two-step instructions. Ability to deal with standardized situations with only occasional or no variables.Other Skills and Abilities - Must be able to identify species, size, and grade of lumber.

WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL ACTIVITY

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.
  • The employee is occasionally required to walk; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear.
  • The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts; fumes or airborne particles and outside weather conditions.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually very loud.

We're looking for talented individuals to operate computer-controlled machines or robots, transforming raw materials into precision-engineered components.

  • Perform a variety of machine shop operations with precision and expertise.
  • Set up and operate CNC Mill machinery, ensuring the accurate shaping and forming of metal to meet specifications.

title: QC Analytical Chemist
description:
Position Purpose and Objectives The QC Analytical Chemist job duties consist of the technical aspects of the department in support of directions from the QC Analytical Lab Supervisor and the Quality Operations Manager. He/She is responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance to FDA Guidelines (DSHEA), customer requirements, and departmental function. The primary responsibility is to develop and validate analytical methods for various dietary finished product matrixes and train analysts and chemists. He/She will support analytical testing of incoming raw materials, in-process samples, stability, and finished goods within the QC Laboratory. Essential Job Functions
• Coordinate the testing of raw materials and finished goods with outside labs when required, and allocate results of said testing to the necessary persons.
• Develop and perform analytical methods based on adaptations of USP, AOAC, NSF, or other industrial resources.
• Write SOPs and methods to meet cGMP's and GLP.
• Validate and qualify laboratory methods including writing of protocols and reports.
• Train chemists and analysts on laboratory methods & procedures when requested.
• Assist and supervise incoming raw materials and finished product analytical analysis.
• Perform daily testing of incoming samples using wet chemical and instrumental techniques, as needed.
• Maintain and record analytical data within prescribed notebooks.
• Compile analytical testing data and issue testing justification documentation.
• Compile lab results and issue completed worksheets for final review.
• Prepare various laboratory reagents as required for daily operations.
• Order and stock all lab supplies required for operation while keeping cost down through effective sourcing and purchasing.
• Ensure accuracy and completeness of all QC logbooks and binders.
• Provide peer review of other chemists' work as needed.
• Ensure that the QC lab is kept in good repair.
• Communicate issues and non-conformances to the QC Analytical Lab Supervisor and Quality Operations Manager immediately.
• Conduct Lab Investigations for all unexpected results. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required
• Must be Proficient in PC functions, (WORD, EXCEL, ACCESS, POWERPOINT, etc.) and Empower software.
• Must be well organized and detail oriented.
• Demonstrate good verbal and written communication skills.
• Be familiar with and demonstrate excellent advanced laboratory problem solving skills.
• Must be experienced in advanced laboratory testing methods.
• Must be knowledgeable in HPLC configuration including column designs, flow rates, reagent variabilities, wavelengths, and detectors.
• Must be knowledgeable in solubility factors, oil products, water-based products, and oil/water emulsions and the impacts to testing formulations of these designs.
• Must demonstrate Good Laboratory Practice in completing daily work assignments.
• Competent in performing mathematical and scientific calculations as they relate to job function. Communication and management skills.
• Ability to manage, carry out, and prioritize analytical functions.
• Ability to see areas that need improvement and to address them. Supervisory Responsibility
• Responsible for ensuring all requirements for Analytical functions are met.
• Responsible for providing an evaluation of the technical performance of analytical chemists as requested. Working Conditions
• Working functions are generally limited to the QC lab with some facility work at times. Minimum Qualifications
• BS Degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry, instrumental analysis, physical chemistry (or extensive analytical laboratory experience in lieu of degree).
• 10 years previous laboratory experience.
• Driven, intelligent, and motivated to succeed and improve.
• Extensive Analytical (HPLC) analysis experience
• Excellent people skills, and ability to function under pressure. Success Factors
• Driven and motivated.
• Technical leadership.
• Intelligent and displays aptitude.
• Problem solving skills.
• Detail oriented.
• Self-motivated team player.
• Well organized.
• Willingness to cooperate and work with other departments.

This position is responsible for the production of high quality cardiovascular medical devices on a team within a manufacturing cell. This position includes detailed assembly and operation of various equipment and machinery per documented procedures. Disposes hazardous waste material on corresponding hazardous waste areas.

Duties
  • Assembles medical devices and related components.
  • Depending on work area, it may be a controlled cleanroom environment.
  • May include use of microscopes, use of hand tools, razor blades, syringes, soldering, adhesive bonding, and operating various equipment.
  • Performs routine assignments according to specified and/or standardized procedures.
  • Work is closely and continually reviewed.
  • Performs visual inspection and precision measurements on components and assemblies.
  • Performs tests on units using computerized test equipment.
  • Repairs and corrects devices/components using microscopes and applicable tools.
  • Packages devices ensuring all parts are accurate and documentation is complete.

description:

Job Summary

 

 The Maintenance Technician performs all tasks necessary to plan, construct, alter, and repair a wide variety of manufacturing machines and building or utility equipment. The Maintenance Technician will also interact with sub-suppliers in case the jobs cannot be done at the company. He or she maintains a high level of accuracy in the tasks performed, in a clean and efficient manner. The Maintenance Technician is an in-house resource for all matters related to the industrial equipment throughout the company.

 

Essential Functions

 

§  5+ years of maintaining and repairing Plastic Injection Molding Machines is required.

§  Prepares maintenance reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.

§  Maintains continuity among work teams by documenting actions and lessons learned to capitalize on team findings and experience.

§  Checks all start up paperwork to ensure machines are released to the manufacturing department.

§  Assists Process Technicians with process start-ups or other technical subjects when necessary.

§  Participates and coordinates real time root cause analysis in conjunction with other Team members.

§  Responsible for 5-S by maintaining a clean, safe, and organized work area at all times.

title: Information Security Risk Analyst
description:
Nesco Data Center & Infra is seeking an IT Analyst in Hauppauge NY for a contractor opportunity.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled Information Security Risk Analyst to join our growing security team. The ideal candidate will play a key role in monitoring, assessing, and responding to security risks across the organization, while collaborating with internal teams and external vendors to ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and investigate potential security threats using tools such as Microsoft Entra and Purview, with a focus on daily review of Risky Users and privileged access.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 security tools, including Entra and Purview.

  • Familiarity with third-party risk management processes and tools (e.g., UpGuard TPRM).

  • Solid understanding of security frameworks and compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA, NIST, SOC 2).

  • Ability to interpret legal and security documentation such as BAAs and vendor certifications.

  • Strong communication and analytical skills; able to interface with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience supporting audits, risk assessments, and incident response processes.

  • Knowledge of vendor and access risk mitigation best practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CISA, CISM, or CISSP.

  • Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, or legal services.

  • Background in vendor management or contract security review is a plus.

title: Project Manager
description:
Core Responsibilities

Manage one or more cross-functional projects of medium to high complexity from beginning to end. Communicate and collaborate effectively within a matrix organizational structure. Learn and adhere to Client processes to ensure project artifacts and deliverables meet Client standards. Lead assigned IT PMO projects with minimal supervision.

Work with the project team to implement best-in-class applications and enhancements. Organize and facilitate status updates, presentations, project schedules, financial reporting, and risk management. Use project management skills to provide project deliverables, identify project risks, and organize workshops and training venues. Some projects will be company-wide, large projects requiring appropriate levels of communication and task coordination to ensure quality delivery.

Understand the triple constraints of a project and control project scope, cost, and schedule. Partner with business partners to uphold the project scope and objectives. Use project management best practices to guide projects with stakeholders and/or business. Deliver projects on budget with desired outcomes, utilizing skills to forecast project financials and effectively communicate any variance to sponsors and required management.

Articulate problems, bring the right people together to solve them, and know when issues have been properly addressed and closed, with the proper sense of urgency. Conduct weekly status reviews with the project team and obtain updates for weekly status reporting and PowerPoint presentations, including updates on timelines, project health indicators, accomplishments, and planned items.

Maintain project governance with regular status meetings, reports, stand-ups, and/or review sessions to keep the team organized and moving toward successful project closure. Screen projects for risks, actions, issues, decisions, financial viability, and opportunities for sustainable improvement. Understand the end-to-end impact along with cross-functional impact and formulate and implement solutions.

Work with multiple vendors, ensuring vendor PM aligns with Client deliverables, SOW, invoicing, and timelines. Collaborate with Financial Analysts to validate financial-related reporting and liaise with project leadership about budget, forecast, accruals, and reclassifications. Update project forecasts, submit accruals, and reclassifications to maintain project financial standards. Monitor project scopes and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility with delivery leads.

Develop detailed project plans/schedules to track progress. Use appropriate verification techniques to manage changes in project scope, schedule, and costs. Manage relationships with clients and all stakeholders. Perform risk management to minimize project risks. Establish and maintain relationships with third parties/vendors. Create, maintain, and store project documentation and records. Define, teach, and enforce good project management practices with the project team.

Communicate frequently and consistently to keep teams aligned and progressing forward. Encourage and support escalations, communicate project milestones, status updates, and any existing or potential escalation issues. Follow escalation and change control processes proactively. Serve as a role model in promoting good working relationships across a project. Cultivate the people skills needed to develop trust and communication among all of a project's stakeholders. description:

Job Title: Induction Operator

Job Summary: The Induction Operator is responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining induction heating equipment to heat metal parts to specified temperatures for forging, forming, or other manufacturing processes. This role requires a strong understanding of induction heating principles, attention to detail, and the ability to work safely and efficiently in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Equipment Operation:

    • Set up and operate induction heating equipment according to established procedures and specifications.
    • Monitor equipment during operation to ensure proper functioning and make necessary adjustments.
    • Use control panels to adjust power levels, frequencies, and other parameters to achieve desired heating results.

  2. Process Monitoring:

    • Monitor the heating process to ensure that metal parts reach specified temperatures and maintain required heating profiles.
    • Use temperature measuring instruments, such as pyrometers and infrared cameras, to verify temperatures.
    • Record process data and maintain accurate records of heating cycles and parameters.

  3. Quality Control:

    • Inspect metal parts before and after heating to ensure they meet quality standards.
    • Identify and report any defects or deviations from specifications.
    • Collaborate with quality control and engineering teams to address any issues.

  4. Maintenance:

    • Perform routine maintenance on induction heating equipment, including cleaning, lubrication, and replacement of worn parts.
    • Troubleshoot and repair equipment malfunctions to minimize downtime.
    • Maintain a clean and organized work area.

  5. Safety:

    • Follow all safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a safe working environment.
    • Use personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.
    • Participate in safety training and contribute to continuous improvement of safety practices.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical or vocational training in a related field is a plus.
  • Experience with induction heating equipment or similar machinery.
  • Basic understanding of electrical principles and heating processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Good manual dexterity and the ability to handle tools and equipment.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Physical stamina to stand for extended periods and lift heavy objects as needed.

Work Environment:

  • Manufacturing or production facility.
  • Exposure to high temperatures, noise, and heavy machinery.
  • Use of protective gear such as gloves, safety glasses, and hearing protection.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand, walk, and move around the facility for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift and carry heavy objects up to 50 pounds.
  • Good hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity.

Additional Information:

  • Pay Rate: $15.50/hr
  • Shift: 1st Shift, 5:00AM-330PM; Monday-Thursday
  • 3 Day Weekend

Company Overview

Howmet Aerospace, headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA, is a leading global provider of advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries. We specialize in jet engine components, aerospace fastening systems, titanium structural parts, and forged wheels for commercial transportation. Our mission is to support the development of more fuel-efficient, quieter aerospace engines and sustainable ground transportation.

The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team leads company-wide financial planning, forecasting, and analytics, working closely with the C-Suite, Investor Relations, and business segments to provide strategic financial insights.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, FP&A will support consolidated financial reporting and administration of critical financial forecasting systems, with an emphasis on Hyperion Planning administration. This role delivers accurate and timely forecasting and reporting, while deriving business insights to guide executive management decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own administration of the Hyperion Planning environment, including system maintenance, data integrity, and user training.

  • Participate in the strategic direction, management, and improvement of FP&A systems and processes.

  • Manage critical source files and business driver models to ensure efficient, accurate reporting.

  • Review monthly actuals, forecasts, and plan performance; analyze variances and provide insights to senior leadership.

  • Prepare quarterly financial reports supporting earnings releases, 10-Q, and 10-K filings.

  • Derive business insights from financial/strategic analysis and synthesize recommendations for senior management.

  • Analyze markets, products, customer revenue, and profitability to recommend actions that drive results.

  • Support capital investment budgeting and approval processes.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to gather financial data, improve processes, and ensure standardization.

  • Conduct competitor and external benchmarking analysis.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).

  • 7+ years of experience in finance, strategy, consulting, or other quantitative roles.

  • 7+ years of experience analyzing financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow).

  • Strong experience with Hyperion Planning (administration required).

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

  • Excellent financial modeling, quantitative analysis, and communication skills.

  • Proven ability to work independently, solve problems, and manage processes under tight deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

  • Highly detail-oriented, process-driven, and collaborative mindset.

Top Skills Sought

  2. Detail- and process-oriented approach

  3. Critical thinking and self-directed problem solving

description:
Are you ready to join an amazing team? Nesco Resource is here to assist you with a great career opportunity. As a brake press operator you will be responsible for setting up and operating a press brake machine to bend and shape sheet metal according to design specifications, ensuring each piece produced meets quality standards by precisely aligning materials, selecting appropriate tooling, and monitoring the bending process while reading and interpreting blueprints to accurately. You will also perform routine maintenance on the machine and inspect finished products for defects.

  • Programming the machine: Using CNC controls to set the bending parameters like pressure, angle, and back gauge position.
  • Operating the press brake: Initiating the bending process and monitoring the machine during operation.
  • Quality inspection: Measuring and inspecting finished parts to verify they meet specifications, including checking for defects and burrs.
  • Troubleshooting: Identifying and resolving any issues that arise during the bending process
  • Maintenance: Performing routine cleaning and lubrication of the press brake

Required Skills:
  • 2 plus years of brake press experience

  • Ability to use measuring tools like calipers and micrometers to ensure precise dimensions
  • Ability to maintaining consistent quality by carefully monitoring the bending process

title: ERP Analyst
description:
The ERP Applications Analyst will own and administer our Infor ERP system. This includes leading the upcoming migration project to advance us from SX.e to CSD, ensuring all of the configurations, integrations, and relevant security precautions are optimized for the business needs, and managing vendor relationships. This role will also need to partner with internal stakeholders to improve processes and drive adoption through training, documentation, and change management.

Responsibilities

  • Lead SX.e to CSD Migration: Oversee project planning, risk/issue tracking, cutover readiness, executive updates, data migration/validation, training, testing strategy, and sign-off.
  • ERP Ownership (Infor CSD): Serve as product owner (roadmap, backlog, adoption, value). Align ERP configurations/integrations with business goals; optimize processes for Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Inventory & Costing. Govern roles/permissions, master data, audit controls. Configure/maintain pricing records and special pricing agreements. Manage EDI onboarding, testing, mapping, and failure resolution.
  • Vendor & Partner Management: Manage ERP support partner (scope, SOWs, SLAs, backlog). Coordinate with internal teams, Infor support, and other vendors (e.g., shipping, EDI).
  • Process Improvement: Identify and document pain points via shadowing, interviews, and data analysis. Map current vs. future workflows, document options, and prioritize improvements (impact, effort, risk, urgency). Pilot and implement changes, draft acceptance criteria, configure/test, coordinate UAT, and prepare SOPs/training. Manage change with communications, super user enablement, and adoption tracking.
  • Change Management & Enablement: Develop role-based training, SOPs, process maps, and quick guides. Facilitate super user forums, feedback loops, and measure adoption/ease of use.

Qualifications:

  • 5-8+ years managing or administering distribution ERP platforms, ideally including Infor CSD.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify ERP-enabled process improvement opportunities and lead cross-functional stakeholders from discovery through implementation and sustainment.
  • Proficiency creating a process map and the ability to translate business needs into clear configuration requirements.
  • Experience with configuring and maintaining pricing records.
  • Experience with configuring and maintaining special pricing agreements.
  • Experience maintaining EDI processes/jobs, monitoring transactions, and working with our partners on new mappings and troubleshooting as needed.
  • Comfortable with the concepts and practice of administering an ERP.
  • Excellent communication with non-technical stakeholders; ability to simplify complex workflows.
  • Strong vendor/partner management (SOW, SLA, support tickets, backlog/prioritization) and project leadership.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Title: Mechanical Engineer III
Duration: 6 months (potential to extend)
Location: 100% in Hickory, NC

Interview Process: Phone/teams screen, the onsite interview if the candidate is local. If the candidate is not local, 2nd interview will be virtual. Manager is willing to consider candidates willing to relocate to Hickory/Charlotte area at their own expense.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:
Bachelors in mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronic Engineering is strongly preferred. Manager is willing to consider candidates with more years experience who lack a Bachelors. 5 years minimum experience required.

WORK SCHEDULE:
Typically M-F, 8-5:00, Some weekends may be necessary to support project installations

SCOPE OF POSITION (i.e. projects involved with and role within group):
The Mechanical Engineer will contribute to the development, design, and integration of advanced automation equipment and precision mechanical systems into manufacturing processes. This role involves the design, development, and delivery of precision automation solutions to meet stringent performance and reliability criteria. The candidate will leverage their expertise in precision mechanical design, motion systems, manufacturing assembly techniques, and system integration to drive innovation and continuous improvement, while ensuring safety and industry standards compliance. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders are essential for success in this role.

DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Develop and design mechanical components, fixtures, and systems for precision automation equipment, ensuring compliance with safety and industry standards
• Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD/Inventor) for detailed design work
• Apply expertise in precision motion control and assembly techniques to develop high-accuracy automation solutions
• Integrate actuators, sensors, and control systems into automation equipment.
• Collaborate with team members on system integration
• Conduct data analysis, troubleshoot, and optimize system performance to meet stringent precision and reliability requirements
• Model systems using fundamental engineering principles, conduct simulations, and execute data analysis using various methods and software tools to validate designs and optimize performance
• Prepare and maintain detailed project documentation, including design specifications, technical reports, and validation protocols

Required Skills (These are skills that candidates MUST possess)
• Proficiency in automation/mechanical engineering fundamentals and principles
• Proficiency in CAD, analysis, and statistical software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoDesk Inventor, Matlab, Python, or R)
• Experience designing and specifying mechanical components and automation solutions for manufacturing such as fixtures, material handling, etc.
• Knowledge of precision motion control systems, including stepper motors, servo motors, and linear actuators. Experience with motion control algorithms and programming
• High level of attention to detail, especially when working on precision applications
• Willingness to stay updated with the latest advancements in automation technology and precision engineering
• Understanding of precision assembly processes and techniques
• Familiarity with tools and equipment used in precision assembly
• Ability to integrate mechanical, electrical, and software components into a cohesive system
• Experience with system-level troubleshooting and optimization
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

DESIRED SKILLS (These are skills that would be nice for candidates to possess)
• Understanding of robotics, actuators, and sensors used in automation
• Familiarity with PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers) and HMI (Human-Machine Interface) design
• Familiarity in using FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) tools for simulation and analysis
• Familiarity with PLC programming languages (Ladder Logic, Structured Text)

SOFT SKILLS (Communication/Team/Leadership)

title: Global Project Manager- Personalized Healthcare
description:
Global Project Manager- Companion Diagnostics

Location: Hybrid (2 days/week on-site in Tucson, Arizona) with approximately 5% travel will be considered.

Shift: 1st Shift
Schedule: Mon - Fri

A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

Job Description:
As part of the Project Management Chapter (PMC), the Global Project Manager (GPM) plays a key role in optimized product delivery, accountable for all project management aspects of various projects from simple to complex in nature. Drives the project/product from the original concept through completion by developing and directing detailed work plans, schedules, project estimates, spending, resource plans, and status reports. As a trusted advisor, the GPM translates and drives projects into products and enables the organization to use energy and time effectively and efficiently while quickly responding to changing business needs across the portfolio.

The Opportunity:
You will drive the delivery of innovative Companion Diagnostics projects, working with both internal project stakeholders as well as external Pharma partners.
You will own project/program/product structures for product development and product care activities, including communication management, timelines, resource and budget plans, progress, and cost control. You will create, coordinate, and maintain integrated project plans, including dependencies, resources, and budgets, allowing your teams to work efficiently and effectively. You will be accountable for quality implementation in complex projects in the following areas: project risk management, critical path analysis, scenario creation and analysis, budget analysis, and robust planning.
You will identify project risks and describe potential implications for budget, timeline, and scope. You will proactively identify gaps, potential bottlenecks or delays, challenge assumptions, and propose innovative options to close gaps and get complex projects back on track while communicating issues proactively to stakeholders.
You will consistently execute project management processes, including guiding and managing preparation for milestone reviews, capacity reviews (cQCR, SCR & fQCR), etc., as applicable, and may lead improvement initiatives. You will implement best practices in project/product teams and foster continuous improvement by sharing best practices and knowledge among peers.
You will select project methodology and apply Agile methods as appropriate, including coaching and guiding teams in project methodology, including Agile practices (with Project/Program Leads or PMC management if appropriate). You have expertise in working in a hybrid Agile role, combining Agile methods (usually within the project/product team) with non-Agile techniques (usually needed with partners and some functions).
You will lead meetings and foster knowledge sharing between project/product teams to enhance project effectiveness and optimized delivery.
You will establish, measure and report Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), standard metrics, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) or Outcome Based Planning (OBPs) key results for projects, enabling teams and functions to measure and improve quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.
You will act as a trusted advisor with a 360° view on all levels to advise and support the project/product teams as well as the broader organization in holistic planning, project risk management, scenario creation as well as critical path analysis, with the aim to ensure optimized value delivery. You will be the single point of contact and control for project and program data collected from the functions.
You will manage project/product team information to support your teams themselves, the Life Cycle Teams (LCTs), and/or other governing body decision-making. Frequently, you will provide high-level, pre-defined and recent planning data for scenario analysis and decision-making on a portfolio level. You will act as Agile Program Manager as defined by Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) where applicable.

Who You Are:
You have demonstrated experience using Planisware, MS-Office, G-Suite and "know-how” of project management tools such as Trello, LucidChart, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps, etc.
You have demonstrated profound problem-solving skills and critical thinking with the ability to synthesize information to identify relevant insights that will advise improvement opportunities
You have a reputation for proactively and successfully driving the delivery of high-complex product development projects, from conceptualization to commercialization.
You have demonstrated interpersonal and influencing skills with an established ability to drive decisions; you have demonstrated ability to identify, facilitate and communicate issues proactively to a wide range of stakeholders
You have strong communication skills (both verbal and written) and presentation skills to enable effective cross-functional collaboration
You have a profound understanding and knowledge of relevant Design Control and/or Phased Development processes
You have a profound understanding and knowledge of healthcare quality, risk, and/or regulatory compliance
You demonstrate good strategic and tactical thinking, and profound analytical thinking.
You have the ability to escalate and drive management decisions in relation to project execution and resource needs.
You have a value delivery mindset.
You hold a Bachelor's degree (from an accredited institution) in science, engineering or business related fields
You have 4+ years project management experience in the diagnostic, medical device, health science, pharmaceutical or biotech industry leading complex new, product development and product care projects. Project management experience in other regulated industries will also be considered.
You have 1+ year of experience in clinical biomarker or In Vitro Diagnostic development, companion diagnostic development, analytical and clinical validations and regulatory submissions or instrument development and program management
You have 1+ year of experience in a regulated industry (e.g. FDA 21 CFR part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 9001)

Preferred:
You hold a Master's degree (from an accredited institution) in science, engineering or business related fields
You have demonstrated experience with Agile development practices and mindset
You have PMP Certification as well as SAFe Certification

description:
Nesco Resource is now hiring for 3rd Shift Tool Room Tech positions at a facility in Forest City.  Training on the job! Awesome perks to include paid benefits once hired on! Apply Now!

Hours: 11:00pm-7:00am
Pay:$17.00-17.75

 

Job Summary:
The Tool Room Technician is responsible for performing a wide range of tasks related to tooling maintenance, repair, and preparation for production. Duties include cleaning die cast and trim dies, operating tool room equipment, performing machining operations, conducting tooling repairs, and supporting preventative maintenance activities. This position may range from entry-level to advanced depending on experience and skill level.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
General Tool Room Functions (All Levels):
  • Clean die cast dies, trim dies, die components, and related tool room equipment.
  • Maintain overall cleanliness and organization of the tool room.
  • Safely operate cranes, lifts, steam cleaners, and compressed air systems.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.
  • Follow company safety protocols and procedures.
Tooling and Machining Responsibilities (By Skill Level):
Trainee / Entry-Level:
  • Assist in tooling repairs and production run preparation.
  • Perform basic lathe and milling operations.
  • Use basic precision measuring instruments.
  • Learn and apply basic tooling concepts and operations.
Intermediate (Class C/B):
  • Perform most tooling repairs and maintenance.
  • Operate lathes and mills for intermediate-level machining tasks.
  • Use a variety of precision measuring instruments.
  • Read and interpret blueprints.
  • Weld and machine components to specified tolerances.
  • Machine components to close tolerances as required.
Advanced (Class A / Lead):
  • Perform all types of tooling repairs, including complex diagnostics and rebuilds.
  • Proficient in all tool room machines and equipment.
  • Use advanced machining techniques and maintain tight tolerances.
  • Fabricate tooling components from blueprints.
  • Provide on-the-job training (OJT) to Class C, B, and Trainee employees.
  • Act as Lead when required, overseeing daily workflow and prioritizing tasks.
Other Duties:
  • Maintain a safe and clean work environment.
  • Assist in training and mentoring junior tool room staff.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the supervisor or lead.
Safety Requirements:
Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):
  • Safety glasses
  • Steel toe shoes
  • Ear plugs
  • Other PPE as specified by supervisor
Safety Knowledge:
  • Emergency Action Plan
  • Hazardous Communication Program
  • Accident Reporting Procedures
  • General Safety Rules and Practices
Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Experience operating tool room equipment (e.g., lathe, mill, welder).
  • Ability to read and understand blueprints and technical drawings.
  • Familiarity with tooling operations and manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and safety awareness.
  • Willingness to learn and grow within the role.

title: Copper Electric Wire Lab Technician 2nd shift
description:
Perform electrical and mechanical tests on copper enameled wire to evaluate quality, performance, and conformance to specifications. Maintain the Enameled Wire (EV) Lab, its equipment, and documentation.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Sample Preparation & Testing:

    • Prepare copper enameled wire samples for testing.

    • Interpret test results against customer/internal specs (e.g., ISO 9001/IATF 16949).

  • Education: High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate's degree or relevant college coursework is a plus).

  • Technical Skills: Proficient in basic math and computer use (especially Microsoft Office).

  • Physical Ability:

    • Lift up to 50 lbs. Push/pull up to 225 lbs.

    • Bend, stoop, climb, reach.

  • Personal Skills: High attention to detail, ability to maintain a clean/organized workspace, good verbal & written communication skills.

  • Work Ethic: Energetic, adaptable to a fast-paced environment, able to follow priorities set by management.

Highly Desired Qualifications (Will Strengthen Application)

  • Experience: 1-5 years experience in a laboratory or manufacturing testing environment.

Work Environment

  • Fast-paced Quality Assurance lab focused specifically on Copper Enameled Wire (CEW).

title: Systems Project Engineer - SysML/CAMEO
description:
Advance Systems or Project Engineering Role

*Prefer local candidates or candidates willing to relocated to be on-site for this project.

*** Engines and Power Systems has an opening within the Military Fixed Wing team. In this role, you will work with experienced engineers to execute Requirements Based Engineering (RBE) and Engine Systems development or Project Engineering work assignments for military gas turbine engines. You will execute process assurance to our systems plans, ensure adherence to requirements style guides, and maintain the DOORS NG spec structures in compliance with our plans. You will execute validation activities and support subject matter experts in developing the product requirements specifications. You will support major System reviews, including the System Requirements Review (SRR) and beyond.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Support requirements development and execution
• Support development and execution of system plans such as the System Development Plan and Requirements Management Verification and Validation Plan (RMVVP)
• Support engine system architecture development, design, and execution
• Possible Cost Account Management (CAM) Duties
• Expected to support the following within the Systems Project team
• Support the program for the assigned module or system
• Leadership capability with diverse, cross functional team
• Escalate effectively with leadership
• Strong commitment to customer satisfaction
• Bias toward creative thinking and innovation in product design and approach to everyday work
• Working knowledge of and commitment to IPDS processes
• Promote strong team working relationships
• Identify gaps and risks on behalf of the team
• Support schedules and budgeted time for the assigned work scope

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
• Due to US export control laws, must be a US Citizen, permanent resident, or have protected status
• 5 or more years Systems, Project engineering or Aerospace program execution experience
• Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related STEM field

WE VALUE
• DOORS NG experience
• MBSE and SysML experience. Prior CAMEO experience.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and manage workload.
• Prior systems engineering experience either through direct industry experience or education/training.
• Ability to execute complex projects in an organized and efficient way
• Capability to facilitate interpersonal relationships and resolve conflicts tactfully and effectively.
• Ability to escalate effectively with leadership and cross-functionally across the organization

title: Engineering Project Manager
description:
PROJECT MANAGER
JOB SUMMARY
The Engineering Project Manager is responsible for managing construction projects through all phases from initial assignment to completion according to project schedules, budgets, and company standards.

JOB DUTIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Performs a variety of tasks, duties, and functions that may include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Develop timelines in the form of Gantt charts or similar means to track activities of Engineering Department employees, consultants, and contractors to assure progress and completion of projects.
  • Manage the design and construction of the Company's projects including SIB projects.
  • Manage projects through all aspects of engineering design, permitting, procurement, construction and commissioning.
  • Prepare technical reports and analyses.
  • Coordinate design concepts and design plans with Division Managers.
  • Develop and maintain effective working relationship with contractors, consultants, government regulatory and permitting agencies.
  • Prepare designs in accordance with applicable codes and standards.
  • Prepare plans, specifications, calculations, bid requests, and cost estimates of materials and labor.
  • Prepare, monitor and manage project budget, project schedule, and adherence to project scope.
  • Manage and administer consultant and construction contracts.
  • Communicate with contractors, consultants, other company employees, vendors, suppliers, management, regulatory agencies, municipalities and others in order to successfully complete construction projects.
  • Write scope of work and bid specifications.
  • Prepare requests for proposals for consulting agreements.
  • Prepare invitation to bid packages and specifications for construction contracts.
  • Manage the consultant and contractor selection process.
  • Review and approve expenditures, change orders and authorizations to bill.
  • Monitor for quality of workmanship and performance to the contract.
  • Initiate communication with contractors to resolve conflicts.
  • Review and approves product submittals.
  • Observe work progress through site visits.
  • Interact with utility companies and governmental agencies to obtain necessary permits and clearances and to ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Establish preliminary project design requirements and prepare preliminary cost estimates.
  • Analyze drawings to determine conformance with company requirements.
  • Other tasks and duties as required.
Qualifications
SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Skills, knowledge and physical requirements include, but are not limited to:
  • Knowledge of principles and practices of engineering, construction plans and specifications.
  • Knowledge of project development, scheduling, monitoring and control systems including construction contract management and practices.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and produce neat and accurate reports.
  • Strong analytical, organizational and problem solving skills.
  • Familiarity with all safety practices and procedures.
  • Familiarity with all Safe Drinking Water Act and Clean Water Standards requirements.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing.
  • Ability to write legibly and have good reading skills, as well as ability to quickly comprehend.
  • Must have strong personal computer skills, and have strong working knowledge of and experience with a variety of computer modeling, design and related software packages, such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Microstation, AutoCAD, GIS related software, and water distribution system modeling software.
  • Thorough understanding of water treatment, filtration, distribution and pumping systems.
  • Knowledge of electrical controls, operational control strategies, SCADA systems, electrical components and electronic instruments.
  • Thorough understanding of City, County, State and Federal permitting requirements for water systems.
  • Ability to manage projects and interact with all levels of company employees, as well as contractors, outside vendors, public agency representatives, and the general public.
  • Ability to accurately handle a high volume of varied tasks, to work well under time deadlines, and to assure the assigned work is completed fully, accurately, and on schedule.
  • Must be dependable, punctual, and have good attendance.
  • Neat and presentable professional appearance.
  • Ability to perform repetitive physical activities using feet, legs, hands, and arms, and be able to use keyboard, walk, sit, stand, bend, stoop, climb stairs, reach, grasp, and occasionally lift up to 75 lbs.
EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE
The following are required:
  • High school degree.
  • Undergraduate degree in Civil, Mechanical or Environmental Engineering from an accredited college or university or a related technical degree desired.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible engineering, project management, construction experience is required, (10 years preferred).
  • Registration as a Professional Engineer in the State of Arizona is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of water utility operations and private water utility economics.

title: Corporate Controller / Chief Accounting Officer (CAO)
description:
Corporate Controller / Chief Accounting Officer (CAO)

📍 Tulsa, OK — Onsite

About the Role

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced financial leader to oversee all aspects of our company's accounting and reporting functions across two locations — Tulsa, OK and 1 out of state. This position may be structured as either a Corporate Controller or Chief Accounting Officer (CAO) depending on your background and experience. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead and mentor an accounting team (five direct reports) while managing core financial operations including AP/AR, payroll, cash management, internal controls, and compliance.

While the role is primarily based in Tulsa, a small percentage of travel (approximately 2–3 times per year, 1-2 day visits) will be required in our out of state location for oversight and alignment.

You'll take ownership of budgeting, forecasting, cost and margin analysis, and consolidated reporting — ensuring accurate, timely financial statements and management reports. As the primary contact for internal and external audits, you will safeguard compliance with GAAP and tax regulations. Beyond day-to-day execution, you'll partner with site leaders to align financial and operational practices and play a critical role in supporting growth initiatives such as acquisitions and expansions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a high-performing accounting team (AP/AR, payroll, Controller, and support staff).
  • Responsible for maintaining costed bills of materials, including FIFO costing, labor and overhead rates, and analyzing favorable/unfavorable variances.
  • Oversee financial operations across two locations.
  • Manage AP/AR, payroll, inventory management, and general ledger functions.
  • Drive budgeting, forecasting, cost/margin analysis, and consolidated reporting.
  • Analyze financial results and budgets, deliver insights and recommendations to support executive decision-making.
  • Ensure all financial reporting, audits, and project deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP, IFRS, SOX (if applicable), and tax regulations.
  • Serve as primary liaison with internal and external auditors.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls to safeguard company assets.
  • Partner with site leaders to align financial and operational practices.
  • Support year-end responsibilities including cycle counts, inventory management, and pre-audit activities.
  • Deliver financial due diligence and integration support for acquisitions ($2M–$20M) (a plus).
  • Present financial insights and recommendations directly to the CEO and executive leadership team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (Master's a plus).
  • CPA strongly preferred but not required.
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting/finance leadership experience.
  • Strong financial leadership with hands-on manufacturing accounting background.
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP/IFRS, internal controls, and ERP systems (Infor VISUAL a plus).
  • Proficiency with pivot tables, Power BI, and ERP/analytics integration.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, communicate effectively, and present complex financial data to executives.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting strict deadlines for both financial reporting and project deliverables.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally (2–3 times per year) out of state for site oversight.

Why This Opportunity?

This is a rare chance to step into a high-impact leadership role, reporting directly to the CEO and shaping both financial operations and strategy for a growing manufacturing organization. You'll lead a capable team, oversee operations across two locations, contribute to meaningful expansion initiatives, and have the ability to leave a lasting mark on the company's financial success.

Position Summary:

Storeroom Attendant is an individual contributor positioned within a customer's location to fulfil daily receiving, stocking, issuing, and cycle counting of customer and/or internal inventory. They are responsible for maintaining a professional, clean and organized work environment.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

•Unloads, receives and puts away incoming product, goods, tools and/or equipment; unpacks bales, crates, and other containers; checks for damage and for discrepancies between goods and invoices.
•Accurately sorts, labels, moves and stores items; places material or items on racks, shelves, or in bins according to predetermined sequence such as size, style, or product codes; arranges storage to optimize crib space.
•Issues product, goods, tools and/or equipment to site employees; documents and maintains accurate records for issued and returned items.
•Enters data into a database or other computerized system to maintain up-to-date stock records; retrieves stored information to respond to inquiries (e.g., inventory levels or delivery schedules.); documents discrepancies on an error log and seeks management advice on appropriate corrective action.
•Requests requisitions to replenish inventory.
•Assists with inventory level maintenance; performs cycle counts and prepares report results.
•Inspects and measures tools/equipment for defects, wear and tear and reports damage or wear to supervisors.
•Prepares periodic inventory or maintains perpetual inventory of supplies and equipment.
•Delivers tools or equipment to associate work locations.
•Investigates and locates lost or misplaced equipment or safety supplies.
•May repair, service and lubricate tools and equipment as required.
•Performs other related duties as requested.

Job Qualifications:

3+ months relevant experience and/or training. High school diploma or equivalent preferred (not required).
Relevant experience and/or aptitude should include:
•Loading, unloading, picking, packing or moving goods in a warehouse environment.
•Demonstrated ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, work orders, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
•Basic computer knowledge and proficiency and/or a demonstrated technical aptitude to learn; preferred technical skills to include but not limited to MS-Office products, Vista, Control, SX.e, Prophet 21.
•Demonstration of basic mathematical skills (add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units to measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals); ability to compute rates, ratio, and percent preferred.
•Strong communication and customer service skills.
•Ability to work in a team environment and be self-motivated to accomplish assigned tasks and goals.
•Demonstration of attention to detail and is safety minded.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

•May be required to wear various forms of protective equipment (shoes, gloves, protective eyewear, etc.)
•May be required to pass warehouse equipment certifications (written and/or driving).
•Assigned work shifts may vary and/or rotate.
•Overtime may be required; extended day, evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand and may include little to no advanced notice.
•Must be able to handle and work physical inventory; required to lift up to 25 lbs or greater with assistance following standard operating and safety procedures. Other physical requirements including, regularly being required to stand, walk, kneel, bend, crouch, crawl, climb and balance.
•Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus are required.

title: Missile Scoring Field Technician - Secret Clearance
description:
Missile Scoring Field Technician Position - Location Panama City FL

Current Secret Security clearance mandatory.
Will work at Tyndal Airforce Base
Panama City, FL

JOB SUMMARY
Performs professional deciphering of Doppler signals generating missile scoring (centroid miss distance, attitude, velocity, closest point of intercept to multiple target points, etc.) for the United States Air Force and other U.S. Services and Allies.
Provide support assistance to the Air Force for their Aerial Gunnery Targets System as well as other assignments of a complex degree under the direction and supervision of the site manager and with latitude for independent action and decision.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide air-to-air and surface-to-air missile scoring in near real-time time constraints in high stress environments for the United States Air Force as well as other U.S. Services and foreign militaries.
• Deploy to multiple physical locations world-wide providing scoring services.
• Evaluate counter-measure operational systems for interference from full-scale and sub-scale target systems to eliminate causes of malfunctions ensuring clean telemetry transmissions/scoring signals.
• Adapt to highly flexible work schedules to provide scoring support at any time day or night as mission times dictate and evolve.
• Perform additional duties that are required to comply with contract requirements to include, Security, Property Control, Training, Quality Assurance, Safety, etc..

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
Five years related experience and/or training or equivalent combination of education and experience directly in the field of Missile Scoring.
Experience in Military/Aerospace Industry and flight line operations mandatory.
Must be able to operate without assistance the GSQ-106D Ground Scoring Station.
Must be able to demonstrate high proficiency in deciphering and tracking inbound, roll-off and outbound Doppler signals generated from the interception of air-to-air and surface-to-air missiles data.
Must be able to generate High Quality final vector and Scalar score reports.
Must be able to support missions in different geological world-wide locations with minimal notification.
Must be flexible to support any scheduled and unscheduled mission requirements.
Current Secret Security clearance mandatory.
Pass recurring drug testing.

Job Description: Research Coordinator

Position Summary

The Research Coordinator is responsible for managing multiple research protocols while serving as a liaison between local investigators, sponsors, and internal teams. Under direct supervision, this role will develop a strong understanding of research operations, regulatory requirements, and best practices in human subject research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Adhere to the organization's Code of Conduct, Mission, and Values.

  • Complete all assigned training requirements on time.

  • Coordinate daily operational activities for multiple research protocols.

  • Serve as the primary contact between site personnel, industry sponsors, and supervisors.

  • Collaborate with finance, hospital administration, and the local IRB, as applicable.

  • Oversee study schedules from feasibility submission to study closeout.

  • Maintain data integrity by reviewing source documents and ensuring accurate case report entries.

  • Develop study-specific documentation tools when not provided by the sponsor.

title: Inspector
description:
1st Shift: 7-3:30pm (Mon-Fri)

Position Summary:
Responsible for inspection of various semi-complex parts, utilizing calibrated tools and instruments to verify conformance to specifications and quality standards.

Primary Responsibilities/Essential Functions:
Responsibilities may include some or all of the following:
1. Maintain accurate and up-to-date acceptance and rejection records and/or certifications systems as required by the applicable specifications.
2. Determine acceptance or rejection after inspection and/or calibration of parts, tools, and instruments. Identify defective conditions and test failures and prepare all appropriate documentation and/or calibration history.

INSPECTION
3. Perform semi-complex inspection of components and shelf-life items, using a wide variety of measuring instruments to determine acceptability or rejections of parts and/or parts finish.
4. Perform inspection on assembled product using a wide variety of measuring and test equipment to determine acceptability or rejections of parts and/or parts finish.
5. Identify product and send samples out for periodic testing to outside laboratory.
6. Adapt and develop inspection set-ups to check sample parts, forgings and castings. Check tool and jig layouts.
7. Perform first article and envelope inspection, source inspections, and/or semi-complex surface plate set-ups.
8. Interpret specifications, records, charts, manuals and other data to arrive at acceptance or rejection. Use mathematics to convert blueprint dimension and tolerances. Work within the guidelines of drawings, schematics, blueprints, route sheets, travelers, quality directives, technical engineering specifications, customer's requirements and military standards.
9. Layout and measure hole locations and centerlines on castings, forgings, and machine parts to maintain control of machining cycle during manufacture.
10. Determine acceptance or rejection after inspecting parts, tools, or instruments. Identify causes of defective conditions and test failures and prepare all appropriate documentation.
11. Investigate cause of customer return failures. Perform inspections to applicable specifications within assembly, test and shipping departments. Assist customer/government source inspectors as necessary.
12. Must be able to clearly communicate internal audit procedure during internal and external audit situations.

CALIBRATION
13. Verifies calibration of instruments and equipment.
Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization

Qualifications
1. Requires high school diploma or equivalent and 3-5 years related inspection, or calibration experience or demonstrated ability to perform described responsibilities.
2. Must be able to pass required vision exam.
3. The person in this position frequently communicates with co-workers about work product and processes and must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. Must be able to read and understand written instructions and procedures. Demonstrates effective interpersonal communication skills as well as the ability to work in a team environment.
4. Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate*** ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs. Possess working knowledge of shop mathematics including trigonometry.
5. Preferred experience of CMM operations, background in dimensioning and tolerancing per ANSI Y 14.5.
6. Knowledge of applicable military standards or specifications required.
7. Proficient in reading and interpreting blueprints, customer's specifications and internal drawings and procedures.

description:
Job Brief:

Lead and influence the design, delivery, automation, and support of network infrastructure services and solutions. This Lead Network Engineer position will have a primary responsibility for networking security solutions supporting our on-premises and off-premises cloud network services portfolio. Additional responsibilities will include providing lead engineering services supporting routing & switching platforms, load balancer platforms and shared network IP services platforms. The Lead Network engineer will be responsible to work with many diverse organizations to ensure we collaborate and communicate on the planning and delivery of all required technology and LOB solutions. Solid communications skills and the ability to prioritize work efforts are required.

· 5-10 years overall IT experience working in a large enterprise environment.

  • Extensive experience with Palo Alto firewall rules in a large, shared environment
  • Demonstrate an ability to craft and understand Palo Alto firewall rule deployments
  • Experience with other firewall technologies in Cloud Environments (GCP, Azure, AWS, etc)

  • Significant experience with TCPDump, Wireshark and analyzing network traffic
  • 5-10 years of hands-on experience with Cisco network technologies
  • 5-10 years of hands-on experience with F5 load balancer technologies

description:
Electrical Controls Project Manager

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Electrical Controls Engineer to join our growing team. This is a key opportunity to work on exciting design-build projects within the steel industry, leading electrical engineering efforts from concept through startup and customer sign-off. You'll apply your expertise in controls, power distribution, and automation to deliver high-quality, innovative solutions.

  • Lead electrical design for power distribution, machine control, and instrumentation.

  • Strong PLC programming skills (Allen-Bradley, Siemens); RSLogix and Step 7 preferred.

  • HMI development and integration experience.

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD for hardware layout and design documentation.

  • Knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70, Arc Flash, and electrical classification standards.

  • Strong background in project management, from design through commissioning.

  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and leadership skills.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for project support.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work on large-scale, impactful projects in the steel industry.

  • Be part of a growing company recognized as a leader in our market.

  • Collaborative, hands-on environment with opportunities for innovation and leadership.

Temp to Perm: Possibility based on workers performance and openings

1. Recent college graduate within the last 3 years with Master's Degree or Ph.D.
2. Min 3 years experience with AI/OT/ controls experience within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or medical device environment.

• Technical Skills:
o Proficiency in PLC programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens), SCADA, and industrial networking.
o Strong command of Python, Power Platform, and AI/ML frameworks.
o Familiarity with digital twins, robotic systems, and smart manufacturing equipment.

title: Warehouse Supervisor
description:
Warehouse Supervisor Job Description

Position Summary

The Warehouse Supervisor oversees and coordinates the daily activities of warehouse staff engaged in materials movement, handling, receiving, loading, unloading, transporting, stacking, order fulfillment, shipping, and inventory management. This role ensures efficient operations, maintains safety and quality standards, and fosters a productive team environment.

Essential Job Functions

  • Operational Oversight (20%): Enforce procedures for verifying incoming and outgoing shipments, handling materials, and maintaining accurate warehouse inventory records.

  • Personnel Management (20%): Schedule warehouse staff to ensure adequate staffing levels; direct daily activities, including shipping, receiving, maintenance, and inventory control.

  • Facility Maintenance (20%): Inspect the physical condition of the warehouse and equipment, prepare work orders for repairs, and requisition replacement equipment as needed.

  • Process Improvement (20%): Review work processes, recommend improvements to production methods, equipment performance, and quality, and suggest changes to enhance efficiency; maintain accurate records and submit required reports.

  • Team Support & Training (10%): Assist employees, vendors, and customers with inquiries related to processes and services; mentor and train team members; address employee concerns and resolve issues.

  • Performance Reporting (10%): Ensure accurate reporting on warehouse activities, including timesheets, productivity metrics (e.g., pounds per man-hour), and efforts to minimize downtime.

  • Other Duties: Perform additional tasks as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.

  • Bilingual proficiency (English and Spanish, written and verbal).

  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in warehouse operations, including tasks such as receiving, inventory management, or order fulfillment.

  • At least one (1) year of experience in a leadership or supervisory role, managing teams or coordinating tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Three (3) or more years of experience in warehouse operations, preferably in a high-volume or food-grade environment.

  • Two (2) or more years of leadership experience, with a focus on training, mentoring, and performance management.

  • Proficiency with warehouse management systems (e.g., SAP, WMS, or similar software).

  • Experience in food manufacturing, vendor management, or regulatory compliance (e.g., FDA, USDA standards).

  • Certification in forklift operation or other material handling equipment.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)

  • Ability to work efficiently and accurately under pressure, meet deadlines, and maintain a professional demeanor both independently and in a team setting.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Environmental/Working Conditions

  • Ability to work overnight shifts, weekends, holidays, and flexible schedules (1st, 2nd, or 3rd shifts).

  • Ability to work in temperature conditions ranging from 35°F to 95°F, occasionally exceeding 95°F.

Physical Requirements

  • Regularly required to stand and use hands/fingers in repetitive motions.

  • Frequently required to walk, reach above head, and lift a minimum of 10 lbs.

  • Occasionally required to stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, crawl, and communicate verbally.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to focus.

  • Exposure to moving mechanical parts, toxic or caustic chemicals, and airborne particles.

  • Noise levels range from standard office environments to loud warehouse settings.
